verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰ ਖੀਰ ਅੰਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਖੁਵਾਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਰੋ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਅਜਾ ਸ੍ਵਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise neer kheer a(n)n bhojan khuvai a(n)t garo kaaT maarat hai ajaa savain kau ||

en.bdb: Just as a male off-spring of a goat, (a he-goat) is brought up by feeding him with milk and food, and at last he is killed by cutting his neck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ਡਾਰੀਅਤ ਲਘੂ ਨੌਕਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਬੂਡਤ ਹੈ ਮਾਝਧਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਗਵਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bahu bhaar ddaareeat laghoo nauakaa maeh booddat hai maajhadhaar paar na gavan kau ||

en.bdb: Just as a small boat is loaded with excessive baggage, then it sinks in the middle of a river where the water is more turbulent. It cannot reach the far bank.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਤਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਮੈ ਅਰਪਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਭਵਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bur naar dhaar bharan si(n)gaar tan aap aamai arapat chi(n)taa kai bhavan kau ||

en.bdb: Just as a prostitute adorns herself with make up and ornaments to excite other males for indulging in vices with her, she herself acquires disease and worry in life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਅਧਰਮ ਨਰ ਮਰਤ ਅਕਾਲ ਜਮ-ਲੋਕਹ ਰਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੬੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee adharam karam kai adharam nar marat akaal jama-lokeh ravan kau ||636||

en.bdb: Similarly, an immoral person dies before his death by indulging in unrighteous deeds. And when he reaches Yamlok (abode of angels of death), he bears more punishment and pain.  (636)
